stem: A 6-year-old girl has speech delay and only follows classroom instructions when the teacher speaks close to her face. She plays well with peers and has otherwise normal gross and fine motor development. What is the most likely explanation?
explanation: Hearing impairment can present as speech delay and apparent inattention, particularly when the child responds better to face-to-face speech. Preserved social play and normal motor milestones make autism or global developmental delay less likely.
